name: Nest Basis Vault
oneLiner: nBASIS is Nest's basis-trade vault token combining Superstate T-bill collateral with perpetual shorts; value drifts with funding-rate, not pegged 1:1.
collateral: Basis-trade strategy book combining tokenised T-bill collateral (Superstate USTB / USCC) on Plume with perpetual short positions; risk-managed and rebalanced by Nest
pegMechanism: Vault LP token whose value targets a dollar base and drifts with the basis-trade strategy NAV; primary mint and redemption occur through Nest at vault NAV against USDC and pUSD

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Nest retains issuer / admin authority over vault shares with permissioned issuance and freeze surfaces beyond reserve-only exposure.

notices.title: Active strategy, not par stablecoin
notices.message: nBASIS runs a basis-trade strategy whose value drifts with funding-rate performance. It is closer in profile to Midas mRe7YIELD than to a 1:1 stablecoin, and Pharos lists it because its primary reference is the U.S. dollar.

mintAuthority.summary: nBASIS is a Nest vault share on the Nucleus/BoringVault architecture; the permissioned Teller mints/burns shares when users deposit pUSD at vault NAV, while the Nest-controlled Manager directs strategy allocation. There is no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route.

controls.label: Nest Basis Vault Teller (issuance/redemption)
controls.evidence: In the Nest/Nucleus BoringVault model the Teller is the only contract that mints and burns vault receipt tokens against pUSD deposits at the Accountant-computed NAV; minting is permissioned through the vault rather than open.

controls.label: Nest Basis Vault Manager (strategy/admin)
controls.evidence: The Manager contract is Nest-controlled and oversees vault strategy, allocation, and configuration; it sits in the admin path over the BoringVault/Teller issuance.

review.evidence: Nest vaults run the Nucleus BoringVault stack (BoringVault token + Teller minter + Accountant pricing + Nest-controlled Manager); shares are minted only by the Teller on deposit and the Manager governs strategy, so supply creation is fully permissioned by Nest. Teller/Manager addresses taken from Nest's published contract list; on-chain role/owner not independently read.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain owner/authority of the Teller and Manager (Safe vs EOA) before raising confidence.
